In parallel, opportunities in e-component procurement, remote service, FSE capacity and installation cost are largely execution-led and sit within BU cost bases, creating a need to avoid duplication and clearly separate enabling investment from BU-owned execution.

A coordinated PD-wide cost competitiveness approach is therefore needed to provide earlier and more reliable cost transparency, establish consistent baselines and benefit attribution, consolidate overlapping opportunities, and enable BUs to convert identified opportunities into sustainable, auditable savings while retaining ownership of the underlying P&L benefits.

The solution will support inventory planning, allocation, tracking, and execution of FCO activities across businesses using SAP and ServiceMax processes.
